turns.customer: I got the Ridgeline Low shoes from order #1036 in mid-August and never wore them. Am I still in time to return them?
turns.reply:
Yes, you are still in time to return the Ridgeline Low shoes! They are eligible for return until September 15, 2026, as long as they are unused and in their original packaging. 

To make a return, you can initiate it from your account where you will find a return label to send the item back. Once the warehouse receives your return, your refund will be issued. Thanks for reaching out!
